home.title: Where Visions Come to Life
home.text: From celebrations in Israel to events abroad, we bring people, places and ideas together through thoughtful planning and a personal approach to every detail.

home.courtyard_alt: A dinner set in the DCity courtyard, black and white

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Weddings, bar mitzvahs and family celebrations in Israel and abroad. Each one designed around its people and its place.

project.invite_text: Tell us about the people, the place and the date. We will take it from there.

about.title: About RIVATAR
about.text: Aesthetics and production are the same work. Every design decision has to look right, and also work on the day itself. RIVATAR began with one wedding at DCity: the founder's own.
about.eye_text: Concept, colour, material and light. Each event gets one visual language, from the first impression to the last detail on the table.
about.hand_text: Timelines, suppliers, logistics and the team on site. Every stage is managed, so that on the day you can be guests at your own event.
about.founder_bio: [About Rivka: her background, what brought her to event production, and what sets her work apart.]

services.title: Services
services.intro: Full design and production under one hand, from the first concept to the last dance.
services.weddings_text: From the concept to the last dance. Design, planning and full production of one day that tells your story.
services.mitzvah_text: Personal production, with a design language built around the family and a scale that suits you.
services.corporate_text: Conferences, product launches, company events and business dinners. A visual language that serves the brand, and management that holds complex timelines.
services.addons_text: Services that can be added to any production.
